description: This file is a shell script used for device initialization and status indicator control based on board type for openwrt. It defines functions to get the status LED based on the board and set the LED state depending on the system phase.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Determines the correct status LED based on the board name.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state according to the provided argument indicating system phase.
